Package data

Class UserData

java.lang.Object
data.UserData
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<UserData>
public class UserData extends Object implements Comparable<UserData>
This is a container class for the User Data. It will be used to store their name and email/phone number, along with their time.
Author:
Nolan Wright
